title: 第二百二十九章 位面撕隙凡血烫仙第二百二十八章 骨血藏链鲜活无终
content_zh:
祖界草的第一百二十三片叶子刚晃完第三下，天就裂了。
不是之前总规炸开时的银灰色乱码，也不是传送门的八彩流光，是一道黑得发亮的缝隙，从阿土刚杵好的柴火垛正上方撕开，风卷着股子从未闻过的冷冽气息灌下来——那气不是凡间的风，刮在脸上像吞了把碎冰碴子，连王婆刚掀开的蒸笼白汽，都被这股气硬生生压回了笼里。
“啥玩意儿？”阿土刚骂出声，就见缝隙里伸出一只无形的手，精准地攥住了站在最边上的陈默。
陈默手里还攥着半块没舍得吃的糖糕，那是王婆今早刚蒸的，多放了半勺糖，他揣在怀里捂得发烫。他想喊阿土，想攥紧手里的旧柴刀，可位面壁的撕扯力太大，声音刚出口就被碾成了碎渣。他只来得及把糖糕往怀里死死按了按，就眼睁睁看着祖界的暖光被黑暗吞掉，连草叶断尺上亮着的草叶纹，都在缝隙闭合的瞬间彻底暗了下去。
……
灵墟，陨星荒原。
陈默是摔在紫色晶石上的，后背撞得闷疼，可远比不上经脉里钻着的疼——这地方的“气”太凶了，冷得像淬了冰的针，顺着毛孔往骨头缝里扎，每动一下都像有碎玻璃在血管里刮。他试着运转以前刻在丹田里的凡气，可那点暖乎乎的气，刚碰到周围的冷气，就像雪粒子落进了火盆，连个响都没发出来就散了。
他咬着牙撑起上半身，旧柴刀还死死攥在手里。刀是之前从总规核心里捡出来的残片，他亲手磨了三天，刀柄上刻着歪歪扭扭的草叶纹——是故意刻歪的，半分不差地复刻了他当年在第一棵祖界草上刻的纹路。可现在，这草叶纹暗得像块死铁，连半点反应都没有。
“高阶位面……”陈默哑着嗓子吐了口血，血落在紫色的灵土上，居然“滋啦”一声，烫出了个小小的黑坑。他愣了愣，抬手摸了摸那坑的边缘，还带着点熟悉的暖意——原来他的凡血，在这冷得要命的地方，居然比灵火还烫。
荒原边缘的晶树林里，云清瑶站在云头，赤足下的紫苔藓连个印子都没留下。
她是偷跑出来的。父帝最近在参悟“太上忘情”大道，把神域里所有带“凡俗气”的东西都清了：蟠桃要摘了蒂，琼浆要滤了渣，连她发髻上的木簪，都因为带了点凡木的纹理，被父帝勒令换成了玉簪。她心里憋着股子说不上来的闷，才趁着护道人烈阳神将闭关，溜到这灵气最稀薄的废土带来散心。
她原本以为这地方只有死物和枯骨，没成想会看见这么个奇怪的“蝼蚁”：浑身是血，却还死死攥着把破铁刀；经脉被灵气压得快碎了，却还咬着牙往地上撑；怀里鼓囊囊的，掉出半块干硬的、沾着血渍的黑糖糕。
云清瑶的眉尖几不可察地蹙了一下。她修行一万两千七百年，吃过九千年一熟的蟠桃，饮过天河底的琼浆，哪样不是灵气充盈、入口生香？可从那半块干硬的糖糕上飘出来的味儿，却和她吃过的所有东西都不一样——没有半点灵气，却带着股子活生生的暖，像她小时候偷偷摸过的、凡间灶台上刚出锅的糕点的味道，甜得她心湖那潭死水，莫名晃了一下。
她下意识往前迈了半步，指尖凝起一缕极淡的紫色灵气，想碰碰那糖糕。
“别碰。”
陈默猛地抬头，眼睛里全是血丝，嘴角还挂着血沫子，声音却哑得坚定，“烫。”
云清瑶的指尖僵在半空。烫？这糖糕干得像块石头，周围灵气冷得能冻碎法宝，哪里来的烫？可她分明看见，陈默说这话的时候，嘴角扯出个极淡的笑，和这荒原的冷、神域的肃穆，格格不入。
“公主殿下！”
一声暴喝从天而降，烈阳神将九轮法相齐出，金光把半片荒原都照得发亮。他看见云清瑶站在废土边，脸色瞬间沉了下来：“这等凡俗蝼蚁，也配让殿下驻足？老臣这就将他碾碎，免得污了殿下的眼！”
他袖袍一挥，一道灵气匹练如天刀斩下，陈默连躲的力气都没有，只能把怀里的糖糕护得更紧，旧柴刀横在胸前，刀身上的草叶纹在灵压之下，居然极其微弱地亮了一下。

“住手。”
云清瑶的声音不大，却带着不容置疑的冷意。她往前踏了一步，素白的流云袖扫过，那道足以劈碎山峰的灵气匹练，居然像撞在了棉花上，悄无声息地散了。
烈阳神将脸色一变：“殿下，这蝼蚁身上俗念深重，留着恐触怒陛下……”
“俗念？”云清瑶低头看着陈默，他正狼狈地趴在地上，却还把糖糕护在胸口，血顺着指缝滴在糖糕上，晕开小小的红印。她忽然想起父帝最近总念叨的“灭世草叶”——说是有朝一日，会有一株带着凡俗气的草叶，烧尽神域的秩序。她指尖那缕灵气无意识地落在陈默的柴刀上，刚好碰到了那歪歪扭扭的草叶纹。
“本宫觉得，这蝼蚁……有点意思。”云清瑶收回手，转身时，流云袖不经意扫过陈默，把他连人带刀卷进了袖里的随身空间，“父帝要修太上忘情，本宫偏要看看，这忘不掉的‘俗念’，到底是什么东西。”
她没看见，陈默的血沾在她的仙衣下摆，洗了三次都没掉，留下个淡红色的、和柴刀上一模一样的草叶印。也没看见，那半块被血浸过的糖糕，在她袖中空间里，居然慢慢散出了热乎的甜香，把周围冰冷的灵气，都暖出了一丝涟漪。
陈默在空间里咳出一口血，却摸索着抓住了怀里的糖糕。糖糕还是硬的，却带着点熟悉的暖，他咬了一小口，甜得发颤。他知道，自己这是到了个完全陌生的地方，规矩全变了，力气全没了，可那又怎么样？
他摸着刀身上歪歪扭扭的草叶纹，咧嘴笑了，血沫子顺着嘴角往下淌：“管你什么神帝仙域，老子有糖糕，有这把歪刀，就能活出个样来。”
荒原的风卷着紫晶石的碎屑掠过，云清瑶站在云头上，指尖摩挲着仙衣下摆那枚淡红的草叶印，万年冰封的眼底，第一次泛起了连她自己都没察觉的、极淡的波澜。
而遥远的祖界，阿土正对着天上那道还没散干净的黑缝骂街，王婆把刚蒸好的糖糕往缝里扔，小娃踮着脚喊“陈默叔回来吃糕”，草叶的断尺正疯狂闪烁，试图追踪那道位面缝隙的轨迹——他们不知道陈默去了哪里，但他们知道，那个刻歪了草叶纹的男人，从来不会输。
凡火不熄，哪怕烧到了神域的屋檐下。
：8xiaoshuo。：wap.8xiaoshuo
content_en:
The 123rd leaf of the ancestral world grass had just shaken for the third time when the sky cracked.
It was not the silver-gray garbled code when the master plan exploded before, nor the eight-color stream of light from the portal. It was a bright black gap, torn open just above the pile of firewood that Atu had just punched, and the wind blew down with a cold breath that I had never smelled before - that breath was not the wind of the world. It blew on the face like swallowing a handful of crushed ice. Even the white steam from the steamer that Wang Po had just opened was forced back into the cage by this breath of wind.
"What the hell?" As soon as Ah Tu cursed, an invisible hand stretched out from the gap and accurately grasped Chen Mo, who was standing at the edge.
Chen Mo was still holding half a piece of sugar cake that he was reluctant to eat. It was steamed by Mrs. Wang this morning. It contained half a spoonful of sugar. He held it in his arms until it felt hot. He wanted to call out to Ah Tu, and he wanted to tighten his grip on the old hatchet in his hand, but the tearing force of the plane wall was too strong, and the sound was crushed to pieces as soon as he left his mouth. He only had time to press Tanggao firmly into his arms, and then watched helplessly as the warm light of the ancestral world was swallowed up by the darkness, and even the bright grass blade patterns on the blades of grass were completely dimmed the moment the gap closed.
…
Lingxu, Meteor Wasteland.
Chen Mo fell on the purple spar, and his back hurt from the collision, but it was far less painful than the pain in his meridians - the "qi" in this place was so fierce, as cold as a needle quenched with ice, following the pores and digging into the seams of the bones. Every time he moved, it was like broken glass scraping in the blood vessels. He tried to circulate the mortal energy that had been engraved in his dantian before, but as soon as the warm air hit the surrounding cold air, it was like snow particles falling into a brazier and dissipated without even making a sound.
He gritted his teeth and propped up his upper body, still holding the old hatchet tightly in his hand. The knife was a fragment that he had picked out from the core of the master plan. He sharpened it with his own hands for three days. The handle of the knife was engraved with a crooked pattern of grass blades - it was deliberately engraved crookedly, and it was an exact replica of the pattern he carved on the first ancestral grass. But now, the grass blade pattern is as dark as a piece of dead iron, without even the slightest reaction.
"Higher planes..." Chen Mo vomited blood with a hoarse voice. The blood fell on the purple spiritual soil, and it made a small black pit with a "sizzle" sound. He was stunned, and raised his hand to touch the edge of the pit, feeling a familiar warmth - it turned out that his mortal blood was actually hotter than spiritual fire in this extremely cold place.
In the crystal forest on the edge of the wasteland, Yun Qingyao stood on top of the clouds, with no trace of purple moss left under her bare feet.
She escaped secretly. My father has recently been meditating on the path of "Tai Shang Forgetting Love", and has purged all the "mundane" things in the divine realm: the peach stalks need to be picked, the fine wine needs to be filtered out, and even the wooden hairpin in her bun was ordered to be replaced by a jade hosta because it had the texture of ordinary wood. She was holding indescribable boredom in her heart, so she took advantage of the guardian Lieyang Shen General to retreat to this wasteland with the thinnest spiritual energy to relax.
She originally thought that there were only dead things and dead bones in this place, but she never expected to see such a strange "ant": covered in blood, but still holding on to a broken iron knife; the meridians were almost broken by the pressure of the spiritual energy, but still holding on to the ground with gritted teeth; half a piece of dry, hard brown sugar cake stained with blood fell out of the bulging arms.
Yun Qingyao's eyebrows frowned almost imperceptibly. She has been practicing cultivation for 12,700 years, has eaten peaches that ripen every 9,000 years, and drank the fine wine from the bottom of the Tianhe River. What is not full of spiritual energy and fragrant in the mouth? But the smell wafting from the half piece of dry and hard sugar cake was different from everything she had ever eaten - it had no aura at all, but had a lively warmth, like the smell of freshly baked cakes that she had snuck in when she was a child. It was so sweet that the stagnant water in her heart swayed inexplicably.
She subconsciously took half a step forward, a faint purple aura condensed on her fingertips, wanting to touch the candy cake.
"Don't touch."
Chen Mo suddenly raised his head, his eyes were bloodshot, and there was blood froth hanging from the corners of his mouth, but his voice was hoarse and firm,"Hot."
Yun Qingyao's fingertips were frozen in mid-air. hot? This candy cake is as dry as a stone, and the surrounding spiritual energy is so cold that it can freeze the magic weapon. Where did it get hot? But she clearly saw that when Chen Mo said this, there was a faint smile on his lips, which was incompatible with the coldness of the wasteland and the solemnity of the divine realm.
"Your Highness the Princess!"
A loud shout fell from the sky, and the nine-round Dharma of the Burning Sun God came out at the same time, and the golden light illuminated half of the wasteland. When he saw Yun Qingyao standing by the wasteland, his face suddenly darkened: "How can such a mortal ant be worthy of His Highness standing? I will crush him now to avoid staining Your Highness's eyes!"
With a wave of his sleeves, a bolt of spiritual energy slashed down like a sword from the sky. Chen Mo didn't even have the strength to hide, so he could only protect the candy cake in his arms tighter. The old hatchet lay across his chest, and the grass blade pattern on the knife's body actually shone extremely weakly under the spiritual pressure.
"Stop."
Yun Qingyao's voice was not loud, but it carried an unmistakable coldness. She took a step forward and swept her plain white Liuyun sleeves. The spiritual energy that was enough to split the mountain peaks actually seemed to hit cotton and dispersed quietly.
Lieyang God General's expression changed: "Your Highness, this ant has a lot of vulgar thoughts. If I keep it, I might offend Your Majesty..."
"Vulgar thoughts?" Yun Qingyao looked down at Chen Mo. He was lying on the ground in embarrassment, but he still held the candy cake to his chest. Blood dripped on the candy cake along his fingers, leaving small red marks. She suddenly remembered the "world-destroying blade of grass" that her father had been talking about lately - it was said that one day, there would be a blade of grass with a mundane taste that would burn away the order of the divine realm. The ray of spiritual energy from her fingertips fell unconsciously on Chen Mo's hatchet, just in time to touch the crooked grass blade pattern.
"I think this ant... is a bit interesting." Yun Qingyao retracted his hand, and when he turned around, Liu Yunxiu swept Chen Mo inadvertently, and rolled him and the knife into the portable space in his sleeve. "My father wants to cultivate the Supreme Being and forget his feelings, but I want to see what these unforgettable 'vulgar thoughts' are."
She didn't see that Chen Mo's blood was stained on the hem of her fairy clothes. It didn't come off after washing three times, leaving a light red grass blade mark exactly like the one on the hatchet. She also didn't see that the half piece of sugar cake soaked in blood slowly exuded a warm and sweet fragrance in the space between her sleeves, causing ripples to warm up the cold aura around her.
Chen Mo coughed up a mouthful of blood in the space, but fumbled and grabbed the candy cake in his arms. The candy cake was still hard, but it had a familiar warmth. He took a small bite and trembled with the sweetness. He knew that he was in a completely unfamiliar place, all the rules had changed, and all his strength was gone, but so what?
He touched the crooked grass blade pattern on the blade and grinned, blood dripping down the corner of his mouth: "It doesn't matter what the God Emperor's Immortal Realm is, I have candy cakes, and with this crooked knife, I can live a good life."
The wind in the wilderness carried the debris of the amethyst stone past. Yun Qingyao stood on top of the clouds, her fingertips caressing the pale red grass leaf mark on the hem of the fairy clothes. For the first time, a very faint wave appeared in her eyes that had been frozen for thousands of years, which even she herself was not aware of.
In the distant ancestral world, Ah Tu was cursing at the black crack in the sky that had not yet cleared up. Wang Po threw the freshly steamed candy cake into the crack. The little kid stood on tiptoes and shouted, "Uncle Chen Mo is back to eat cake." The blades of grass were flashing crazily, trying to trace the trajectory of the crack in the plane - they didn't know where Chen Mo went, but they knew that the man with the crooked pattern of grass leaves would never lose.
The ordinary fire will not be extinguished, even if it burns under the eaves of God's Domain.
